name: National Statistics Office of Viet Nam
what_it_actually_measures: Census, household living standards (VHLSS), CPI, retail sales, population by province and age band. The only population denominator in Viet Nam that is not a platform estimate
what_it_cannot_see: Brand preference, purchase intent, channel behaviour. It measures the economy, not the market for your product
use_for: Sizing a market from the bottom up: households x incidence x frequency x price. Sanity-checking any penetration claim against real population
do_not_use_for: Anything about attitude or brand. Do not quote a CPI figure as evidence that a price point works

name: General Statistics Office (former domain)
what_it_actually_measures: Nothing. The domain no longer resolves
what_it_cannot_see: Everything
use_for: Recognising a stale deck. Almost every Vietnamese marketing deck still cites this host, which means the author did not open it
do_not_use_for: Citing. Replace with nso-vn and re-verify the specific table, because the renaming moved URLs as well as the host

name: Ministry of Information and Communications (former)
what_it_actually_measures: Nothing. The ministry was merged and the domain no longer resolves
what_it_cannot_see: Everything
use_for: Same tell as gso-vn-dead. Telecom, internet and publishing statistics moved with the merger
do_not_use_for: Citing. Look for the function under the Ministry of Science and Technology and confirm the table still exists rather than assuming it was carried over

name: Ministry of Science and Technology
what_it_actually_measures: Post-merger home of telecom, internet subscriber and publishing statistics
what_it_cannot_see: What a subscriber does with the connection. A SIM count is not a person and a person is not a session
use_for: Subscriber and infrastructure counts, once it responds
do_not_use_for: Relying on it inside a deadline. It returned 503 on 2026-07-30; have the NSO figure as a fallback

name: DataReportal Digital Viet Nam
what_it_actually_measures: Platform self-reported advertising reach, restated per country. The headline social numbers are ad-audience sizes taken from each platform's own campaign planner
what_it_cannot_see: Real people. Meta and TikTok report addressable ad accounts, which include duplicates, dormant accounts, bots and users outside the stated age band. There is no deduplication across platforms
use_for: Direction of travel, year-over-year change, and a fast free citation for a slide
do_not_use_for: Penetration. "78% of Vietnamese are on Facebook" is a statement about ad accounts divided by population, and the two numerators come from different universes. Never divide an ad-reach figure by an NSO population figure and call the result penetration

name: Decision Lab
what_it_actually_measures: Recurring online consumer panel: brand usage, app usage, sector trackers, generational splits
what_it_cannot_see: Offline-only and rural low-connectivity consumers, by construction of an online panel
use_for: Quarterly brand and app share movement, generational contrast
do_not_use_for: Absolute market share. An online panel over-represents urban, younger and higher-income respondents, which is the same skew as most Vietnamese online panels

name: Q&Me
what_it_actually_measures: Survey research on a Vietnamese online panel, published as free short reports
what_it_cannot_see: Same online-panel skew. Sample sizes are often in the hundreds
use_for: Cheap directional read on a specific consumer question, and question wording worth reusing
do_not_use_for: Precision. Check n and fielding dates on each report; a 300-respondent national claim has a margin of error near 5.7 points at 95% confidence, which is wider than most differences being argued about

name: YouNet Media
what_it_actually_measures: Social listening: public, indexed, machine-readable mentions on Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, forums and news
what_it_cannot_see: The channels where Vietnamese purchase conversation actually happens. Closed Zalo groups, private and secret Facebook groups, livestream comment streams, DMs, and text rendered inside images are all outside the index
use_for: Share-of-voice movement, crisis detection, competitor campaign timing
do_not_use_for: Concluding that a channel does not matter because it is quiet. In Viet Nam the systematic under-count falls hardest on the closed and live channels that convert best, so listening data is biased against exactly what you want to find

name: Kompa
what_it_actually_measures: Social listening and data analytics, same indexed-public-text constraint as younet-vn
what_it_cannot_see: Same blind spots as any listening tool
use_for: Reputation tracking and campaign monitoring where a second vendor is wanted for triangulation
do_not_use_for: Treating two listening vendors as independent confirmation. They index overlapping public sources and inherit the same closed-channel blindness

name: Metric
what_it_actually_measures: Marketplace listing data scraped from Shopee, Lazada, TikTok Shop: listing counts, prices, and revenue inferred from displayed sold and review counts
what_it_cannot_see: Direct sales through Zalo, Facebook, livestream and messaging, which is a large share of Vietnamese SME revenue. Also cannot see returns, cancellations or net revenue
use_for: Category price ladders, competitor assortment breadth, which SKUs carry the volume on marketplace
do_not_use_for: Total category size or true revenue. Displayed sold counts are seller-influenceable and inferred revenue is gross of the high Vietnamese COD return rate

name: Sapo reports
what_it_actually_measures: Aggregate behaviour of retailers using Sapo point-of-sale and ecommerce software, published as annual retail reports
what_it_cannot_see: Non-customers. The panel is self-selected: businesses that bought retail software
use_for: Small and mid retail operating reality: channel mix, payment mix, what owners report about demand
do_not_use_for: Projecting to all Vietnamese retail. Software-adopting retailers are more digitised than the base

name: Vietnam E-commerce Association
what_it_actually_measures: Annual Vietnam E-Business Index and member surveys on ecommerce adoption
what_it_cannot_see: Consumer-side behaviour; it surveys businesses
use_for: Provincial ecommerce readiness, B2B adoption, policy context
do_not_use_for: Consumer demand estimates

name: Coc Coc
what_it_actually_measures: Search and browsing behaviour of its own Vietnamese browser and search userbase, plus published trend reports
what_it_cannot_see: Users of Chrome and Safari, who are the majority
use_for: A Vietnamese-language search-intent read that Google Trends smooths away, and a non-Google keyword source
do_not_use_for: Total search volume. This is one browser's slice, not the market

name: Google Trends Viet Nam
what_it_actually_measures: Relative, normalised, sampled search interest indexed 0-100 within the query and window you chose
what_it_cannot_see: Absolute volume. The index is rescaled to your own comparison set, so the same term shows a different number depending on what you compare it against
use_for: Seasonality, relative term comparison, breakout query discovery
do_not_use_for: Absolute demand, or comparing two screenshots taken with different comparison sets and different date windows

name: Kantar Worldpanel Vietnam
what_it_actually_measures: Household purchase panel: what households actually bought, recorded from receipts and scanning, for FMCG
what_it_cannot_see: Non-FMCG categories, services, and out-of-home consumption in the standard panel
use_for: The closest thing to ground truth on FMCG share, penetration and buying frequency
do_not_use_for: Assuming coverage of your category without checking. Panel scope and rural coverage are commercial questions to ask before buying

name: NielsenIQ Vietnam
what_it_actually_measures: Retail measurement from store audits and scanner data, plus consumer panels
what_it_cannot_see: Traditional trade coverage varies and is the central question in Viet Nam, where general trade remains a large share of FMCG volume
use_for: Retail measurement where modern trade dominates the category
do_not_use_for: Blind trust in traditional-trade projections. Ask for the store universe and audit frequency

name: Brands Vietnam
what_it_actually_measures: Industry press: campaign write-ups, agency announcements, local case studies in Vietnamese
what_it_cannot_see: Performance. Case studies are supplied by the agency that made the work
use_for: Local campaign vocabulary, what the Vietnamese industry is talking about, competitor activity
do_not_use_for: Effectiveness evidence. A published case study is a marketing artefact about marketing

name: Advertising Vietnam
what_it_actually_measures: Same category as brandsvietnam: local industry press and case studies
what_it_cannot_see: Whether a campaign worked. A case study is written by the agency that sold it, so the result is a claim and the failures are absent
use_for: Second local industry source for triangulating what is actually running
do_not_use_for: Same as brandsvietnam. It blocked a plain request on 2026-07-30, so a browser session is required

name: VNETWORK reports
what_it_actually_measures: Vietnamese internet infrastructure, CDN and traffic commentary, often the local restatement of global digital reports
what_it_cannot_see: Original consumer research
use_for: Infrastructure and connectivity context in Vietnamese
do_not_use_for: Treating a restatement as a primary source. Trace the figure back to whoever measured it

name: Meta Ad Library
what_it_actually_measures: Ads currently or recently running, by advertiser and country, with creative and start date
what_it_cannot_see: Spend, results, targeting and audience for commercial ads. Only political and social-issue ads carry spend ranges
use_for: What a competitor is actually running right now in Viet Nam, offer cadence, creative volume
do_not_use_for: Effectiveness. Ad count is a budget and workflow signal, not a performance signal. Long-running does not mean winning

name: TikTok Commercial Content Library
what_it_actually_measures: Paid commercial content by country and date, with some metadata
what_it_cannot_see: Organic performance, spend, targeting detail
use_for: Format and hook patterns actually flighted in Viet Nam
do_not_use_for: Assuming regional completeness. Coverage and fields vary by jurisdiction

name: Google Ads Transparency Center
what_it_actually_measures: Verified advertisers' ads by region and format
what_it_cannot_see: Spend and performance outside political advertising
use_for: Confirming an advertiser is active and in which formats
do_not_use_for: Share-of-spend estimates

name: Google Ads image asset requirements
what_it_actually_measures: Current accepted display sizes, file limits and asset requirements
what_it_cannot_see: Nothing relevant; it is a specification
use_for: Building a banner set against live platform requirements
do_not_use_for: Caching. Re-open before every flight; sizes and limits change without notice
